Season and year of HIV screening and diagnosis

methods_quotes.q: Maximum likelihood phylogenetic analysis was employed to compare the pol, gag, and env sequences from this investigation with genetically similar sequences from GenBank
HIV-1 subtype B was determined using the online subtyping tool COMET
